q: Where is the headquarters of Indian Bank?
explain: Indian Bank is headquartered in Chennai, as is Indian Overseas Bank.

q: Where is the headquarters of Central Bank of India located?
explain: Central Bank of India has its head office in Mumbai.

q: The Antwerp Diamond Bank specialises in serving the diamond and diamond jewellery sector. Where is its headquarters?
explain: As the name suggests, the bank is based in Antwerp, Belgium, the diamond-trading city.

q: Where is the headquarters of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB)?
explain: AIIB is headquartered in Beijing, China.

q: Where is the headquarters of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) situated?
explain: ADB is headquartered in Manila, in the Philippines.

q: Where is the headquarters of the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) located?
explain: BIS serves central banks and is based in Basel, Switzerland, with representative offices in Hong Kong and Mexico City.

q: NongHyup Bank, which was added to the Second Schedule of the RBI Act, 1934, has its headquarters in which country?
explain: NongHyup Bank is a commercial bank in Seoul, South Korea.

q: In which state is the headquarters of NSDL Payments Bank situated?
explain: NSDL Payments Bank is headquartered in Maharashtra (Mumbai).

q: In which state is the headquarters of Federal Bank located?
explain: Federal Bank is a private sector bank headquartered at Aluva in Kerala.

q: Where was Canara Bank first set up in 1906?
explain: Canara Bank began in Mangalore in 1906; its headquarters is now in Bengaluru.

q: Which public sector bank has the tagline ‘Your Tech-friendly bank’?
explain: Indian Bank’s tagline is ‘Taking Banking Technology to Common Man; Your Tech-friendly bank’.

q: Where is the head office of Indian Overseas Bank located?
explain: IOB’s head office is in Chennai.

q: Where is the headquarters of UCO Bank?
explain: UCO Bank is the public sector bank headquartered in Kolkata.

q: The logo of which of the following banks has a star in it?
explain: The Bank of India logo carries a star, and its tagline is ‘Relationship beyond Banking’.

q: What is the tagline of Karur Vysya Bank?
options: Taking Banking Technology to Common Man
explain: KVB’s tagline is ‘Smart way to Bank with’. The other options belong to Indian Bank and Indian Overseas Bank.

q: ‘Taking Banking Technology to Common Man’ is the tagline used by which bank?
explain: It belongs to Indian Bank, not Indian Overseas Bank, whose line is ‘Good people to grow with’.

q: Central Bank of India started functioning in which year?
explain: Central Bank of India dates from 1911, which is why its tagline says ‘Central to you since 1911’.

q: What is the tagline of HDFC Bank?
explain: HDFC Bank’s line is ‘We understand your world’. ‘Good people to bank with’ is Union Bank of India.

q: Where is the headquarters of Canara Bank?
explain: Canara Bank is headquartered in Bengaluru though it started in Mangalore.

q: ‘World’s Local Bank’ is the tagline of which bank?
explain: HSBC uses the line ‘The world’s local bank’.

q: Which bank is headquartered in Mangaluru?
explain: Karnataka Bank has its head office in Mangaluru; Federal Bank is in Aluva (Kerala).

q: What is the tagline of Dhanlaxmi Bank?
explain: Dhanlaxmi Bank uses ‘Tann. Mann. Dhan’. ‘Serving to Empower’ is J&K Bank’s line.

q: What is the tagline of Bank of Baroda?
explain: Bank of Baroda says ‘India’s International Bank’. ‘One Family One Bank’ is Bank of Maharashtra.

q: Which pair of banks is headquartered in Karur?
options: Lakshmi Vilas Bank and Karur Vysya Bank
Canara Bank and Karur Vysya Bank
Lakshmi Vilas Bank and Vijaya Bank
explain: Both Karur Vysya Bank and Lakshmi Vilas Bank were based in Karur, Tamil Nadu. Lakshmi Vilas Bank has since merged with DBS Bank India.

q: Select the correct tagline of ICICI Bank.
explain: ICICI Bank’s line is ‘Hum Hai Na’.

q: Where is the headquarters of South Indian Bank?
explain: South Indian Bank is headquartered at Thrissur in Kerala.

q: What is the tagline of Jammu & Kashmir Bank?
explain: J&K Bank’s tagline is ‘Serving to Empower’.

q: Where is the headquarters of State Bank of India?
explain: SBI is headquartered in Mumbai.

q: Where is the headquarters of Punjab National Bank?
explain: PNB has its headquarters in New Delhi, as does Punjab & Sind Bank.

q: In which city is Bank of Baroda headquartered?
explain: Bank of Baroda’s head office is in Vadodara, Gujarat.

q: Which public sector bank has its headquarters in Pune?
explain: Bank of Maharashtra is the public sector bank with its head office in Pune.

q: Which of these public sector banks is NOT headquartered in Mumbai?
explain: PNB is in New Delhi. Bank of India, Union Bank and Central Bank are in Mumbai.

q: Which pair of public sector banks has headquarters in the same city, Chennai?
options: Punjab National Bank and Punjab & Sind Bank
Indian Bank and Indian Overseas Bank
Canara Bank and Union Bank of India
UCO Bank and Bank of India
explain: Both banks with ‘Indian’ in the name are in Chennai. The two Punjab banks are in New Delhi.

q: ‘Good people to bank with’ is the tagline of which bank?
explain: Union Bank of India says ‘Good people to bank with’, while IOB says ‘Good people to grow with’.

q: ‘Honours Your Trust’ is the tagline of which public sector bank?
explain: UCO Bank uses ‘Honours Your Trust’.

q: ‘One Family One Bank’ is the tagline of which public sector bank?
explain: Bank of Maharashtra’s tagline is ‘One Family One Bank’.

q: ‘Where service is a way of life’ is the tagline of:
explain: This is Punjab & Sind Bank’s line.

q: Which public sector bank was established in 1943?
explain: UCO Bank dates from 1943, IOB from 1937 and Union Bank from 1919.

q: Which two public sector banks were both established in 1908?
options: Bank of India and Canara Bank
Indian Bank and Central Bank of India
Bank of Baroda and Punjab & Sind Bank
Union Bank of India and UCO Bank
explain: Bank of Baroda and Punjab & Sind Bank were set up in 1908. Bank of India and Canara Bank share 1906.

q: Which tagline matches Central Bank of India?
options: Build A Better Life Around Us; Central to you since 1911
explain: Central Bank’s taglines refer to building a better life and its year of birth, 1911.
